Launcher of the Dragon Block Resurrection server for Android.
DbrLauncher Mobile is an unofficial modified version of ZalithLauncher.

Thanks to KAMKEEL (Kam), author of the addon together with bigguy345 (Goatee) and somehussar (Hussar), for allowing us to distribute to players, through this launcher, our modified version (an unofficial fork) with credit to its authors. Granted on 2026-10-05.

Thanks to Benjámin Nagy (Ben), of JinGames, authors of Dragon Block C, JRMCore, JBRA Client, Family C and Years C, for allowing us to create and use addons that extend their mods. Granted on 2026-10-06. Their mods are used unmodified.
Dragon Block Resurrection is an independent project: it is not affiliated with JinGames or KAMKEEL.
Base launcher DbrLauncher Mobile is built on (unofficial fork, GPL-3.0).
Render engine used by the experimental modpack. By artDev, SerpentSpirale, CADIndie and contributors (MojoLauncher). Included unmodified, built from commit 9dc80cb.

string-array.name: dbr_launch_tips
string-array.item: Tip: if you see a black screen, try another engine in Settings > Performance.
Tip: with the Lite modpack the game runs smoother on low-end phones.
Tip: you can move and resize the buttons from the in-game menu.
Tip: camera sensitivity is set from the in-game menu.
Tip: if the game closes, use Settings > Help > Report a problem and send it on Discord.
Tip: lower the resolution in Settings > Performance if you notice lag.
Tip: change the language of the launcher and of the game in Settings > Game.

resources.string: An unstable connection or the phone screen turning off cut the download. Check your internet and try again; it resumes where it left off.
